message.content:
Here’s a classic list of ingredients you’ll need to bake a delicious chocolate cake. Feel free to adjust quantities or add extras (like espresso powder or a splash of orange liqueur) to suit your taste. | Ingredient | Typical Quantity (for a 9‑inch round cake) | Notes | |------------|-------------------------------------------|-------| | All‑purpose flour | 1 ¾ cups (220 g) | Sifted; use cake flour for an extra tender crumb. | | Granulated sugar | 2 cups (400 g) | White sugar gives a sweet base; you can swap half for brown sugar for a richer flavor. | | Unsweetened cocoa powder | ¾ cup (75 g) | Dutch‑processed cocoa yields a milder, darker chocolate flavor. | | Baking powder | 1 ½ teaspoons | Leavening agent; ensures the cake rises. | | Baking soda | 1 ½ teaspoons | Works with acidic cocoa for a lighter texture. | | Salt | 1 ½ teaspoons | Balances sweetness. | | Eggs | 2 large | Room‑temperature eggs help create a smooth batter. | | Whole milk | 1 cup (240 ml) | Room‑temperature; can substitute with buttermilk for a tangy twist. | | Vegetable oil | ½ cup (120 ml) | Neutral‑flavored oil keeps the cake moist. | | Vanilla extract | 2 teaspoons | Adds depth; pure vanilla is best. | | Boiling water | 1 cup (240 ml) | Hot water dissolves cocoa and flour, creating a silky batter. | | Optional extras | | • 1–2 tablespoons espresso powder (enhances chocolate flavor)
• ½ cup chocolate chips or chopped chocolate (for a chocolate‑chip cake)
• ¼ cup sour cream or Greek yogurt (extra moisture) | **Optional frosting (chocolate buttercream):** | Ingredient | Quantity | |------------|----------| | Unsalted butter | ½ cup (115 g), softened | | Cocoa powder | ⅓ cup (30 g) | | Powdered sugar | 3–4 cups (360–480 g) | | Milk or heavy cream | 2–4 tablespoons | | Vanilla extract | 1 teaspoon | | Pinch of salt | | **Tips:** - **Sift dry ingredients** together to avoid lumps and ensure even distribution of leavening agents. - **Room‑temperature eggs and milk** help create a smoother batter and better rise. - **Add boiling water last** to keep the batter from cooling too much before baking. - **Bake at 350 °F (175 °C)** for about 30–35 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean. - **Cool in the pan for 10 minutes**, then turn onto a wire rack to cool completely before frosting. Enjoy your chocolate cake!
